blocks.p: From the living room to the loading dock. Same agent, same history, more room.
Not ready for a plan? Start free. Send us the bills. We check them.
Works with the tools you already run.

stockbot is an agent you text. Send it a photo or PDF of an invoice, quote or packing slip and confirm the figures it pulls out. It checks them against your orders and flags overcharges, missing items and price changes. It can draft the reply to your supplier for you.

blocks.text: What happens to my data when I upgrade?

blocks.p: It comes with you. Your documents, order history, suppliers and setup move into your Everstock workspace. There is nothing to export or re-enter.

blocks.text: How does per-seat pricing work on Base?

blocks.p: No. Everstock works from your documents and spreadsheets. If you already run an ERP, Enterprise plugs into it.

blocks.text: Which platforms do you work with?

blocks.p: Shopify, Etsy, Excel, Google Sheets and your ERP. stockbot works by text.
